about:
Louisiana Shirt Company operates from Baton Rouge, Louisiana. The business was formerly known as DTF GANG LLC before rebranding. No founding year or founder names are disclosed, and ownership structure is not specified.

The company produces direct-to-film (DTF) and UV DTF gang sheets in custom and pre-made configurations, with sheet sizes ranging from 22 by 12 inches up to 22 by 240 inches. It also offers ready-to-press transfers, including college and sports-themed designs, as well as faux rhinestone and faux sequin transfers. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are published.

Customers include ETSY sellers, small apparel decorators, and hobbyists seeking heat-transfer materials for garments and hard goods. The site features testimonials from individual buyers but does not name commercial accounts or specific industries beyond custom apparel and promotional products.

Louisiana Shirt Company emphasizes same-day shipping for orders placed by 12 PM CST and same-day local pickup for orders placed by 1 PM CST. It also provides buy-now-pay-later options through Afterpay and PayPal Pay Later. No further mission statement or origin story is provided.
